meta.name: reply-handler
meta.description: Analyze cold outreach replies and craft the right response based on a relationship-first philosophy. Use when asked "how to reply to this", "they said X what do I say", "handle this objection", "got a response from a prospect", "interested reply", "not interested reply", "next step after reply", "competitor objection", "pricing question", or "how do I respond to this email/LinkedIn message". Always use this skill before writing any reply to a prospect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析潜在客户回复并生成恰当跟进话术
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要回复潜在客户的邮件或领英消息，却不确定如何措辞。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze prospect replies and craft appropriate follow-up responses.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to reply to prospect emails or LinkedIn messages but aren't sure what to say.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析冷外联回复的类型（感兴趣、软兴趣、反对、硬拒绝等），并基于关系优先理念生成 2-3 条礼貌、简短的回复草稿，同时给出分析（意图、语气、紧急度等），帮你把每次回复转化为关系机会。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说“如何回复这个”“他们说了X我该说什么”“处理这个反对意见”等，或请求分析冷外联邮件/领英消息的回复时触发。

say.text: 这个客户说“价格太高”，我该怎么回复？
say.note: Claude 会分析反对类型并给出策略和回复草稿。

say.text: 收到一封感兴趣的回复，帮我安排下一步。
say.note: Claude 会生成锁定会议的具体回复建议。

say.text: 他们用竞争对手，如何应对？
say.note: Claude 会提供对比和优雅退场方案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes cold outreach replies (positive interest, soft interest, objection, hard no, etc.) and crafts 2-3 polite, concise response drafts based on a relationship-first philosophy. It also provides analysis including intent, tone, urgency, and decision-maker status.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how to reply to this", "they said X what do I say", "handle this objection", or similar requests to analyze a cold outreach email/LinkedIn message reply.

say_en.text: This client said 'price too high', how should I reply?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the objection and provides strategy and draft.

say_en.text: Got an interested reply, help me schedule the next step.
They use a competitor, how to handle?
say_en.note: Claude offers comparison and graceful exit options.
